The background is dark, emphasizing the subject. A liquid is being dripped onto it from above. The liquid starts at the top edge of the roll and causes the paper to darken and deform as it is added. original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a cylindrical object, which appears to be a roll of toilet paper, placed on a white plate with a black rim. The background is dark, emphasizing the subject. Initially, the toilet paper looks intact but begins to melt and char as a liquid, possibly a chemical or a hot substance, is poured onto it from above. The liquid starts at the top edge of the roll and gradually spreads downward, causing the paper to darken and bubble. As the liquid continues to pour, the paper becomes increasingly charred and deformed, with the edges curling inward and the center becoming more solidified. The transformation is rapid, and by the end of the sequence, the toilet paper is almost entirely blackened and melted, with only a small portion remaining unburned at the top. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing solely on the melting process without any additional elements or characters entering the frame.
caption: The video captures a roll of white paper towels standing upright on a white plate with a black rim, set against a dark blurred background and a wooden surface. A large section on the upper-left of the roll is already soaked with a brown liquid that has run down the side, and a dark circular hole sits at the top center. From the top-right corner, a white spout continuously pours a thin stream of clear liquid onto the upper-right surface of the roll. As this stream keeps falling, it feeds a brown wet patch already present there, which spreads leftward toward the central hole. The stained area around the hole grows larger and more saturated, partly obscuring the opening visible earlier. Meanwhile the pre-existing brown stain on the left side becomes glossier and darker, while the vertical drip running down the side remains visible. The plate, roll, and background appear largely fixed, with no obvious camera movement.
